message.text: I want to check server.go to see where the RSS service is set up and whether it uses the same markdown service instance as APIV1Service or creates a separate one.
All confirmed — a single `service` instance is constructed once and shared across all holders.

h13.

**Implementation:** the unexported `*service` struct in `internal/markdown/markdown.go:57-113`, which wraps a `goldmark.Markdown` instance (built with `extension.GFM` plus the custom `TagExtension`/`MentionExtension`) — this is the sole runtime implementation of the `markdown.Service` interface (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:31-55`).

**Construction:** `markdown.NewService(markdown.WithTagExtension(), markdown.WithMentionExtension())` is called once in `NewAPIV1Service` (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:47-51`), producing a single shared instance. (A separate instance is also built the same way in the test helper `server/router/api/v1/test/test_helper.go:44`, used only for tests.)

**Holders of the interface:** the one production instance from `NewAPIV1Service` is then threaded into every other component that needs it, rather than each constructing its own:
- `APIV1Service.MarkdownService` (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:35`) — the constructing holder
- `RSSService.MarkdownService` (`server/router/rss/rss.go:45`) — passed in via `rss.NewRSSService(s.Profile, s.Store, apiV1Service.MarkdownService)` at `server/server.go:85`
- `memopayload.Runner.MarkdownService` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:16`) — populated via `memopayload.NewRunner(store, markdownService)` (constructor at `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:19-24`), though note (per h08) this runner is never actually instantiated/wired into production startup.
